asked.line: To ever have one last, and so, no questions asked
stanza: Now, Jerry had a girl, the only one of us
To ever have one last, and so, no questions asked
She'd be the fourth one involved
In the middle of November we went back into the woods right after breakfast to…
At the barricade, I stood listening
In my backpack you were sleeping with her hat pulled low
All the usual birds were gone or freezing
It was all silent except the sound of one crow following us as we wove through…
I walked and you bobbed and dozed, sweet kid
We were watched and followed and I thought of Geneviève
Sweet kid, I heard you murmur in your sleep
"Crow," you said
"Crow," and I asked
"Are you dreaming about a crow?"
And there she was
Then I got dressed
I dressed the kids as well
The limousine pulled in, and we piled in
The doctor he asked
Which way we were headed
I said "Sir, let's just go west", and he listened obediently

asked.line: Even though no one has ever asked:
stanza: Knowing no one will understand these songs
I try to sing them clearer
Even though no one has ever asked:
"What does Mount Eerie mean?"
